digest.component_or_area: Development process audit evaluation and historical decision recovery
propositions: Six process-improvement recommendations from bleakish-stational-cob audit require evaluation against prior decisions, outcomes, and new evidence to establish sound disposition for future work.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was implemented as optional, present-only capture in prior work; coverage is 1.1% but the mechanism worked; expansion should target known automated-filler and agent-session boundaries without global mandates or backfill.

Deterministic plan preflight floor exists at P1-P11 (not P1-P8); blocking should extend only for recurrent mechanically decidable failures with offline replay validation, explicit false-positive ceilings, and fail-open behavior.

Completion-failure classification must first derive categories offline from 351 existing failure sidecars with 682 structured findings before adding schema, because first-non-PASS outcomes mix implementation defects, unmet ACs, missing evidence, and tool failures.

Risk-tiered review should pilot reporting without merge enforcement using available prospective signals (security/store surfaces, diff breadth, complexity, plan-review failures); autonomous governance has no human Gerrit review so proposed human-approval requirement is inapplicable.

Proactive debt management's 720-LOC warning already shipped; future work should prioritize concrete clone families and architectural seams, not arbitrary code-size quotas, and verify metric health because prior headroom indicator emitted false zeros.
